Label: util_eatout_distance_to_destination_duration_less_than_1_hr
Description: EAT-OUT - Distance to destination - Duration < 1 hr
Formula: where(alt.duration < 2, (where(alt.duration <= 2, min(2 - alt.duration, 47), 0) + where(alt.duration > 2, min(alt.duration - 2, 14), 0)) * origin_to_destination_distance, 0)

Label: util_eatout_distance_to_destination_duration_greater_than_1_hr
Description: EAT-OUT - Distance to destination - Duration > 1 hr
Formula: where(alt.duration > 2, (where(alt.duration <= 2, min(2 - alt.duration, 47), 0) + where(alt.duration > 2, min(alt.duration - 2, 14), 0)) * origin_to_destination_distance, 0)

Label: util_eatout_low_income_duration_less_than_1_hr
Formula: where(person.is_income_less25K and alt.duration < 2, where(alt.duration <= 2, min(2 - alt.duration, 47), 0) + where(alt.duration > 2, min(alt.duration - 2, 14), 0), 0)

Label: util_eatout_medium_income_duration_less_than_1_hr
Formula: where(person.is_income_25K_to_60K and alt.duration < 2, where(alt.duration <= 2, min(2 - alt.duration, 47), 0) + where(alt.duration > 2, min(alt.duration - 2, 14), 0), 0)

Label: util_eatout_zeroauto_HH_duration_greater_than_1_hr
Description: EAT-OUT - Zero auto HH - Duration > 1 hrs
Formula: where(household.auto_ownership == 0 and alt.duration > 2, where(alt.duration <= 2, min(2 - alt.duration, 47), 0) + where(alt.duration > 2, min(alt.duration - 2, 14), 0), 0)

Label: util_eatout_university_student_departure_after_7_pm_linear
Description: EAT-OUT - University student - Departure after 7:00 pm - Linear
Formula: where(alt.start > 32 and person.ptype == 3, where(alt.start <= 32, min(32 - alt.start, 29), 0) + where(alt.start > 32, min(alt.start - 32, 8), 0), 0)

Label: util_eatout_female_duration_less_than_1_hr
Formula: where(alt.duration < 2 and person.female, where(alt.duration <= 2, min(2 - alt.duration, 47), 0) + where(alt.duration > 2, min(alt.duration - 2, 14), 0), 0)

Label: util_eatout_female_duration_greater_than_1_hr
Formula: where(alt.duration > 2 and person.female, where(alt.duration <= 2, min(2 - alt.duration, 47), 0) + where(alt.duration > 2, min(alt.duration - 2, 14), 0), 0)

Label: util_eatout_time_pressure_departure_before_6_30_pm
Description: EAT-OUT - Time Pressure - Departure before 6:30 pm
Formula: where(alt.start < 32, min(32 - alt.start, 29) * log10(30 * (tt.max_time_block_available(tour.person_id) / (1.0 + tour.tour_count - tour.tour_num))), 0)

Label: util_eatout_time_pressure_duration_less_than_1_hr
Formula: where(alt.duration < 2, min(2 - alt.duration, 47) * log10(30 * (tt.max_time_block_available(tour.person_id) / (1.0 + tour.tour_count - tour.tour_num))), 0)

Label: util_eatout_departure_constant_shift_for_every_30_minutes_before_5_30_pm_linear
Description: EAT-OUT - Departure Constant: Shift for every 30 minutes before 05:30 pm - Linear
Formula: where(alt.start < 31, where(alt.start < 30, min(30 - alt.start, 27), 0) + where(alt.start > 34, min(alt.start - 34, 6), 0), 0)

Label: util_eatout_departure_constant_shift_for_every_30_minutes_after_8_pm_linear

Formula: where(alt.start > 34, where(alt.start < 30, min(30 - alt.start, 27), 0) + where(alt.start > 34, min(alt.start - 34, 6), 0), 0)
